hero.subtitle: ABOUT
hero.title: Built inside a facility service company that runs on it every day
hero.body: DFMG Platform was not designed from the outside. It was built by people who run a facility service company, and it is how we plan, run and prove our own week at our clients' sites.

story.subtitle: OUR STORY
story.title: From spreadsheets to one system
story.body1: DFMG started as a facility service company in Denmark, with the week in spreadsheets, the team on a group chat and the proof in everyone's own phone.
story.body2: We built a scheduler for ourselves, then the app for the team on site, then the photos and times that prove every visit. One tool led to the next, until our week ran in one system: the office, the employee app and the client portal.
story.body3: Today we run our own facility service company on it, and we offer it to other Danish service companies whose people work at their clients' sites.
story.vision: one system to run the whole business.

philosophy.subtitle: PHILOSOPHY
philosophy.title: What we believe
philosophy.card1_desc: Every feature exists because we needed it in our own business. We don't build based on market research — we build based on daily operational reality.
philosophy.card2_desc: Built in Denmark by a Danish service company, around how Danish service companies work. The system is in English today, and the Danish translation is under way.
philosophy.card3_desc: When an employee checks in or takes a photo, the office sees it on the visit straight away. No manual re-entry, no data silos, no sync issues.

tech.subtitle: TECHNOLOGY
tech.title: Modern, secure, scalable
tech.item1_text: each company gets its own isolated database schema
tech.item2_text: the application, the database and photos run in EU data centres
tech.item3_text: with a code from an authenticator app, or with a passkey
tech.item4_text: ASGI server with WebSocket support for live updates
tech.item5_text: employees access their tasks, schedule, and reports from any device
tech.item6_text: enable only the modules you need, disable what you don't

cta.title: See the company behind the platform
cta.body: DFMG runs a facility service company in Denmark — the same company that built and uses this platform every day.

hero.subtitle: OM OS
hero.title: Bygget i en facility service-virksomhed, der selv kører på den hver dag
hero.body: DFMG Platform er ikke designet udefra. Den er bygget af folk, der driver en facility service-virksomhed, og det er der, vi planlægger, kører og dokumenterer vores egen uge hos vores kunder.

story.subtitle: VORES HISTORIE
story.title: Fra regneark til ét system
story.body1: DFMG startede som en facility service-virksomhed i Danmark, med ugen i regneark, holdet i en gruppechat og dokumentationen i hver enkelts egen telefon.
story.body2: Vi byggede en vagtplan til os selv, derefter appen til holdet ude hos kunden, derefter billederne og tiderne, der dokumenterer hvert besøg. Ét værktøj førte til det næste, indtil vores uge kørte i ét system: kontoret, medarbejder-appen og kundeportalen.
story.body3: I dag driver vi vores egen facility service-virksomhed på den, og vi tilbyder den til andre danske servicevirksomheder, hvis folk arbejder hos deres kunder.
story.vision_label: Hvor vi er på vej hen:
story.vision: ét system til at drive hele virksomheden.

philosophy.subtitle: FILOSOFI
philosophy.title: Det vi tror på
philosophy.card1_desc: Hver eneste funktion eksisterer, fordi vi selv havde brug for den i vores virksomhed. Vi bygger ikke ud fra markedsanalyser — vi bygger ud fra daglig operationel virkelighed.
philosophy.card2_desc: Bygget i Danmark af en dansk servicevirksomhed, efter hvordan danske servicevirksomheder arbejder. Systemet er på engelsk i dag, og den danske oversættelse er i gang.
philosophy.card3_desc: Når en medarbejder checker ind eller tager et billede, ser kontoret det på besøget med det samme. Ingen manuel genindtastning, ingen datasiloer, ingen synkroniseringsproblemer.

tech.subtitle: TEKNOLOGI
tech.title: Moderne, sikker, skalerbar
tech.item1_text: hver virksomhed får sit eget isolerede databaseskema
tech.item2_text: applikationen, databasen og billederne kører i datacentre i EU
tech.item3_text: med en kode fra en godkendelsesapp eller med en adgangsnøgle
tech.item5_text: medarbejdere tilgår opgaver, vagtplan og rapporter fra enhver enhed
tech.item6_text: aktiver kun de moduler du har brug for, deaktiver resten

cta.title: Se virksomheden bag platformen
cta.body: DFMG driver en facility service-virksomhed i Danmark — den samme virksomhed, der har bygget og bruger denne platform hver dag.
